paite: Huai lai in Hezekiah, muanmohhuai in achi ana hi. Huchi in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai akiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Na inkote omdan ding gel in; damkhe zou lou a si ding na hi ngal a," achi hi.
heading: Hezekiah Chinatna Leh Adam Nawnna / (Isa 38.1-8,21,22; 2 Kro 32.24-26)
english: In those days Hezekiah was sick and dying. Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him, and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Set your house in order; for you will die, and not live.’”

paite: Huchi in baang lam nga in akihei a, TOUPA kiang ah,
english: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed to Yahweh, saying,

paite: "TOUPA aw, na ma a thutak leh lungtang hoihkim pu a ka omdan leh na mitmuh a thil hoih ka hihdan hehpih in theigige in," chi in athum hi. Huchi in Hezekiah kah petmah in akap hi.
english: “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

paite: Isai huangsung intual laitak atun ma in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung hi.
english: Before Isaiah had gone out into the middle part of the city, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,

paite: "Kik nawn inla, ka mite heutu Hezekiah kiang ah gen in, TOUPA'N, na pu David Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Na thumna ka za a, na khitui kia leng ka mu hi. Ngai in, ka hon damsak ding a; ani thum ni in TOUPA' inn ah na hohtou ding.
english: “Turn back, and tell Hezekiah the prince of my people, ‘Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will heal you. On the third day, you will go up to Yahweh’s house.

paite: Na damsung kumte kum sawm-le-nga in ka behlap dia; nang leh hiai khopi Assuria kumpipa a pan ka humbit ding.' Keimah ziak leh ka sikha David ziak in hiai khopi ka hum ding, achi," chi in.
english: I will add to your days fifteen years. I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.”’”

paite: Isai in, theipi gah beu khat hon la un, achi a; huchi in ahon la ua, ameimatum ah atat a, ahong dam nawnta hi.
english: Isaiah said, “Take a cake of figs.” They took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

paite: Hezekiah in Isai kiang ah, "TOUPA'N ahon damsak dia, TOUPA' inn ah ani thum ni in ka hohtou ding, chih chiamtehna bang ahi dia?" achi hi.
english: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “What will be the sign that Yahweh will heal me, and that I will go up to Yahweh’s house the third day?”

paite: Isai in, TOUPA'N athil gen ahih ngei ding chih hiai nang a ding in TOUPA a pan chiamtehna ding ahi ding, "Limliap kalbi sawm tan, amailam a akintouh hia na deih, kalbi sawm tan a anunglam a akik?" achi hi.
english: Isaiah said, “This will be the sign to you from Yahweh, that Yahweh will do the thing that he has spoken: should the shadow go forward ten steps, or go back ten steps?”

paite: Hezekiah in adawng a, "Limliap kalbi sawm tan amalam a kintouh abaih tel a, huai zaw hi kei henla, limliap kalbi sawm tan in nunglam ah nungkik zaw hen," achi hi.
english: Hezekiah answered, “It is a light thing for the shadow to go forward ten steps. No, but let the shadow return backward ten steps.”

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Isai in TOUPA asam a; huchi in Ahaz dak zah theihna a limliap niamsa kalbi sawm tan in nunglam ah akiksak nawn hi.
english: Isaiah the prophet cried to Yahweh; and he brought the shadow ten steps backward, by which it had gone down on the sundial of Ahaz.

paite: Huai lai in Hezekiah chi ana chih ana zak ziak in Baladan tapa Babulon kumpipa Merodak-baladan in laikhakte leh thilpiakte Hezekiah akhak hi.
heading: Babulon A Pan Thupawtute
english: At that time Berodach Baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah in amau ana kipahpih a, athil manpha koihna inn a thil manpha tengteng, dangka, dangka-eng, gimlimte, sathau manpha, agalvan koihna inn teng leh agou koihkhawmna insung a om tengteng a-ensak a: a-inn leh agamsung a Hezekiah in a-etsak louh a-om kei hi.
english: Hezekiah listened to them, and showed them all the storehouse of his precious things—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, or in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.

paite: Huai lai in zawlnei Isai kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, "Huai mite'n bang ahia agen uh? Koi a pan na kiang a hong hoh ahi ua?" chi in adong hi. Hezekiah in, "Gam gamla, Babulon a kipan a hong hoh ahi uh," achi hi.
english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and said to him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a far country, even from Babylon.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Na inn ah bangbang ahia amuh uh?" achi a; Hezekiah in, "Ka insung a om tengteng amu vek ua, ka gou lak ah ka etsak louh a-om kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: He said, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”

paite: Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah, "TOUPA thu ngaikhia in.
english: Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear Yahweh’s word.

paite: Ngai in, na insung a om tengteng leh tuni tan a na pi-le-pute'n ana kholkhawmte uh Babulon ah apaipih nite uh ahong tung ding; bangmah nutsiat anei kei ding uh TOUPA'N achi.
english: ‘Behold, the days come that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store to this day, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Na gil a gah, na suan ding, na tapate ngei leng apaimangpih ding ua; Babulon kumpipa' inn ah michilgeh ahi ding uh," achi hi.
english: ‘They will take away some of your sons who will issue from you, whom you will father; and they will be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.’”

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah in Isai kiang ah, "Na gen TOUPA thu ahoih ahi,” achi hi. "Ka damsung a lemna leh thutak a-om ding nakleh hoih himai lou hia?" achi hi.
english: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “Yahweh’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “Isn’t it so, if peace and truth will be in my days?”

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah tanchin dangte, athilhihtheihdan tengteng leh dil leh tuilakna abawl a, khopi sung a tui alaklut thute Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
heading: Hezekiah Vaihawm Tawpna / (2 Kro 32.32,33)
english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made the pool, and the conduit, and brought water into the city, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; atapa Manasseh asik in alal hi.
english: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
